status: experimental, not used by the installed extension
scope:
Experimental GPU solver accuracy and timing, using Blender's own GPU API.

Default probes use 1024 stratified vertices. Pass --full-grid on a hardware
GPU for fresh 65-cube timing; --allow-software only validates the shader.
Shader compilation is reported separately from warm dispatch/readback.
This developer experiment does not select a new installed render method.

solver_policy.inverse: 2-variable regular Broyden with fixed-reference H-K inverse and bracketed Newton Tone inverse; full-forward 3-variable Broyden recovery
solver_policy.gpu_timing_includes: parameter/input packing, texture creation/upload, all device iterations/Stack entries, one readback per phase; numerical_bake_seconds also includes AP1 conversions and float32 cube storage

photographic_policy.arithmetic_reference: complete CPU float64 path; gpu_arithmetic excludes LUT interpolation
photographic_policy.cpu_lut_and_gpu_lut: same nonuniform 65-cube and physical-linear tetrahedral interpolation
